title: Cookie Policy
intro: Like most web applications, Vibed stores a few small pieces of information in your browser, as cookies or in local storage. This page lists all of them. We do not use advertising or audience measurement cookies, and no third party tracks you across sites through Vibed.

sections.title: 1. Strictly necessary
blocks: These are needed for the service to work, or keep a setting you chose. The law does not require consent for them, and they cannot be turned off without breaking Vibed.

head: Name
Purpose
Duration
rows: Until you sign out or the session ends
Lets your browser load your own videos securely. Signed, HttpOnly, never readable by scripts
Temporary session when you use the editor without an account
Local copy of the open project and its undo history, so no work is lost
Remembers the onboarding tour and tracks uploads and exports in progress
Your choice in the cookie banner

sections.title: 2. Optional, with your consent

head: Tool
Purpose
Duration
rows: Sentry Session Replay (provider: Sentry, data stored in Germany)

When the editor hits an error, a short replay of the screen helps us understand and fix it. All text and input fields are masked, and images and videos are blocked, so the replay shows the layout of the page and never your content. Nothing is recorded if no error occurs.
Replay buffer kept for the browser session; replays kept up to 90 days

blocks: This tool only runs if you click Accept in the banner. If you refuse, the editor works exactly the same.

sections.title: 3. Content loaded from other services
blocks: The editor loads its caption fonts from Bunny Fonts, a European service that does not set cookies or log visitors' IP addresses. Error reports (without replay) are sent to Sentry to help us fix bugs; they do not use cookies.

sections.title: 4. Changing your choice
blocks: You can change your choice at any time. It takes effect immediately.
You can also delete cookies and local storage in your browser settings. Doing so signs you out and removes local copies of unsaved work.

sections.title: 5. More information
blocks: How we handle personal data in general is explained in our [Privacy Policy](/privacy). For any question, write to [{{email}}](mailto:{{email}}).
